Vertigo is a bullet-hell game where you'll explore the dreamstate and battle manifestations of your subconscious mind.
Your goal is to survive as long as you can.
Use A/D to move left and right.
Use the left analogue stick to move left and right.
Your character perpetually falls. Touching the gravity line inverts your vertical momentum.
Power gradually regenerates over time. The more power you've used, the longer it will take to regain a charge.
Attack and destroy hazards to gain gems.
Collect enough gems and you will Ascend.
Each time you Ascend, you get to choose one out of the three upgrades.

In the GRAZE state, you gain a massive power regeneration boost and begin accumulating gems, filling up your gem bar over time.

Vertigo - a sensation that you, or the environment around you, 
is moving or spinning.

Vertigo - a common physical symptom that results in a sensation of movement, 
usually a spinning feeling.

Vertigo - a spinning sensation that distorts one's sense of balance and causes 
a feeling of nausea or being off balance.

Vertigo - a physiological phenomenon characterized by a false perception of motion 
when there is no external stimulus present.

Vertigo is defined in medicine as a false sensation of movement, 
and is often caused by a dysfunction in the inner ear or brain.

Vertigo is but an illusion of the mind brought forth from an imbalance of bodily perception. 
It reveals the limitations of our physical bodies and the fragility of our grasp on reality.

The breath of Vertigo encircles your mind.
Your senses spiral, whirling to chaos.
